c74object.name: evi_svfs_tpt_filters
c74object.digest: A GenExpr file, part of 'evieve', for using via 'require()'
c74object.description:
evi_svfs_tpt_filters.genexpr is a .genexpr file and is part of the 'evieve' Package.
It is for using in a gen.codebox~ or in another .genexpr file via the require() command.
By declaring require("evi_svfs_tpt_filters.genexpr"); at the top of a codebox you can then access all of the functions included in this file.
The evi_svfs_tpt_filters.genexpr file also requires:
evi_smooth.genexpr
evi_svfs_filters.genexpr
About this File:
This file includes standalone versions of all TPT SVF coefficients calculators and filter sections that use them for use in gen~/GenExpr. Require this file to include any of the available filters for this type. So if you just need a standard high quality lowpass (for example), you need only require this file then call 'eviFilterLowpass(x, cutoff, db, Q, smooth=0)' in your code. These are the 'workhorse' linear filters of evieve and are used everywhere in the Package.

entry.name: tptSvfCoeffLowpass ( )
entry.description:
Filter coefficients for the TPT SVF
In 1: type=input: cutoff, Cutoff frequency in Hz
In 2: type=input: gain, Gain (linear)
In 3: type=input: Q, Q
Return 1: g, g coefficient
Return 2: r, r coefficient
Return 3: h, h coefficient
Return 4: cL, low mixing gain
Return 5: cB, band mixing gain
Return 6: cH, high mixing gain
